name: Zintro
description: Zintro is an expert network whose B2B network and Concierge Program were acquired by Focus Crossroads in September 2026. Its app now says public services are no longer available through that website.
aiCapabilities: Participant recruitment for third-party AI interview platforms (legacy)
pricingDetail: Zintro's client page advertises project-based pricing without cost or credit minimums or mandatory subscriptions. These are legacy terms; confirm current pricing with Focus Crossroads following the asset acquisition.
keyDifferentiators: B2B expert network and Concierge Program acquired by Focus Crossroads in September 2026
Legacy custom recruitment and project support
bestFor: B2B research recruitment via Focus Crossroads
overview:
On September 9, 2026, Focus Crossroads announced the acquisition of Zintro's B2B expert network, Concierge Program, and specialized professional audience assets, effective immediately. The buyer says the acquired network includes more than 130,000 verified professionals, including more than 50,000 C-suite leaders and senior executives, and is being integrated into its recruitment operations.

Zintro's app now states that public services are no longer available through that website. Its marketing pages remain accessible and describe full-service recruitment for research. Buyers should confirm current services and engagement terms with Focus Crossroads.

history.narrative: Zintro was founded in 2007. A March 2010 company press release identifies Stuart Lewtan as founder and describes a marketplace with anonymous client-expert messaging. Zintro's investor page says the idea arose while its founder was an executive-in-residence at Battery Ventures in Boston.

timeline.event: Founded, according to Zintro’s About page
Company press release describes anonymous client-expert messaging and identifies founder Stuart Lewtan
Focus Crossroads announces acquisition of the B2B expert network and Concierge Program

servicesDetailed.name: Legacy Full-Service Research
servicesDetailed.description: Zintro's About page describes custom recruiting, screening, compliance checks, scheduling, transcription, and expert payments. Availability after the asset acquisition requires confirmation with Focus Crossroads.

servicesDetailed.name: Legacy Surveys & Quantitative Research
servicesDetailed.description: Zintro's investor page describes B2B surveys alongside expert interviews for investment research.

servicesDetailed.name: Legacy AI Interview Recruitment
servicesDetailed.description: In an August 7, 2025 case study, Zintro says it recruited and onboarded participants for studies conducted on clients' chosen AI moderation platforms, and handled scheduling, incentives, and support.

aiPlatform.narrative: Zintro describes using a proprietary AI search model to identify relevant profiles in a payroll research case study. Its AI interview case study describes recruitment for third-party platforms rather than a Zintro moderation product. These are legacy examples; current availability after the asset sale is unconfirmed.
features: Recruitment and participant support for third-party AI-moderated research

complianceExtended.narrative: Zintro's published compliance page prohibits experts from sharing confidential information, including material non-public information, and requires clients to stop a call and notify Zintro if prohibited information is disclosed. These published policies do not establish the compliance arrangements for services after the acquisition.
highlights: Zintro says it checks projects before and during launch and monitors changes
Experts must respect contractual restrictions and keep client information confidential

clientFit.narrative: Zintro's legacy client page addresses research firms, consultancies, investors, and corporations. Following the acquisition, buyers seeking B2B participants should discuss requirements with Focus Crossroads.

strengths: Legacy full-service support covering recruitment through expert payment
caveats: Zintro's app says public services are no longer available through that website
Current pricing, service availability, and compliance arrangements should be confirmed with Focus Crossroads
The 130,000+ acquired-network count is company-stated as of September 2026; the larger figure on legacy marketing pages describes a different population and is not interchangeable
notableFacts: Zintro's investor page still markets more than 1,000,000 individuals; this is a company claim, not the size reported for the assets acquired in September 2026
In its August 7, 2025 AI interview case study, Zintro reports that 82% of 50 surveyed participants preferred AI moderation to live interviews; this is a company-reported study result
